page.overview:
Who is Serenity?

Serenity is the placeholder name of a male background Pegasus pony with a pink coat, dark blue (sometimes bright yellow) mane and tail, grayish blue eyes, and a cutie mark of three raindrops.

Serenity shares his design and cutie mark with Warm Front and "Dewdrop", his design with Starburst, "Cloud Break", "High Note", "Sunlight", and "Silverwing", his mane and tail design and color scheme with "Gingerbread", his mane and tail design and coat color with Ace Point and S01E21 Unnamed Earth Stallion #10, his mane and tail design and color with "Strawberry Cream", his mane and tail design and eye color with Golden Delicious, Cherry Fizzy, "Black Stone", "Cormano", S04E22 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #2, "Gary Coronet", and S05E06 Unnamed Earth Stallion #7, his mane and tail design with S01E02 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, Caramel, "Black Marble", Royal Riff, Doctor Horse, Wensley, BeauDe Mane, "Neon Brush", Upper East Stride, "Medallion Gold", S04E12 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #2, S04E22 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, S04E22 Unnamed Earth Stallion #2, S04E22 Unnamed Earth Stallion #9, S04E24 Unnamed Earth Stallion #4, S04E24 Unnamed Earth Stallion #6, S04E26 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, S05E05 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, S05E06 Unnamed Earth Stallion #8, S05E10 Unnamed Earth Stallion #4, and S05E12 Unnamed Earth Stallion #2, and his tail design with Business Savvy.

Serenity appears later in Rainbow Falls flying about the Equestria Games qualification tryouts in much the same way as his first appearance. In Equestria Games, he flies up with other Pegasi to stop the ice cloud from falling onto the stadium.

In season five, Serenity appears in Tanks for the Memories moving clouds from Cloudsdale to Ponyville for winter.
